name: Amy Morgan
bio: Amy Morgan (born 12 December 1988, Pencoed, Bridgend, Wales) is a Welsh actress, active since the early 2000s. She trained at the Royal Welsh College of Music & Drama and was spotted by TV casting directors while playing the title role in Trelawny of the Wells at the Donmar Warehouse, which led to her recurring role as Grace Calthorpe Selfridge in ITV's Mr Selfridge (2013–2014, 30 episodes, opposite Jeremy Piven).  On stage she has performed at the National Theatre (Dear Octopus, Exit the King, The Beaux' Stratagem), in the West End (Red Velvet, Hay Fever, Travesties as Gwendolen), and at the Royal Court (A Kind of People). In 2024 she received an Off West End Theatre Award nomination for a new adaptation of Hedda Gabler.  Her filmography spans over 30 credits across film and television. Notable film credits include No Time to Die (2021, as Alison Smith, with Daniel Craig), Pan (2015, as Operator), We Live in Time (2024, as Leah, with Florence Pugh and Andrew Scott), and Wuthering Heights (2026, as Zillah, with Jacob Elordi and Margot Robbie). On television she has appeared in Showtrial (2021, as Heidi McKinnon, 5 episodes), Steeltown Murders (2023, as Young Jean Hughes, 4 episodes), The Pembrokeshire Murders (2021, as Erin Davies), Call the Midwife (2022, as Pamela Heslop), Beyond Paradise (2025, as Stella Ellis), Death Valley (2025, as Sioned Grant), Playing Nice (2025, as Jen, 2 episodes), Ten Percent (2022, as Chloe Miller), Marriage (2022, as Louise), Baker Boys (2011, as Shelly, 6 episodes), and Father Brown (2013, as Ruby Adams).
place: Pencoed, Bridgend, Mid Glamorgan, Wales, UK
